$comment: absorb technique registry (ADR-0600, ABS-A). ONE file, lane-scoped rows, never per-lane forks (A5). Lives in products/absorb/ rather than .claude/scripts/absorb/ because products/ is OUTSIDE the sync surface: a registry is written on every technique transition, and .claude/** is hash-pinned in tests/fixtures/sync-golden/tree-manifest.txt, so housing it there would put a byte-identity gate in front of routine data writes (ADR-0606 Amendment 1). ROW SHAPE, all fields required unless marked nullable: id (T-NN, unique) | name | status (candidate|trial|adopted|retired) | lane | source {name, pin, url, license} | classification_ref (path to the extraction report that classified it) | evidence (array of paths, may be empty) | attribution (nullable; REQUIRED and non-null when source.license is permissive and any code was copied rather than re-expressed - ADR-0601) | lock_ref (nullable; {name, version} referencing capability-lock.json when the technique carries an executable artifact - NEVER a hash, publisher-auth, class or provenance copy, those live in the lock alone per A5 and REQ-04) | decision_refs {adopt, retire} (nullable each; a ULID from decision.recorded - a transition to adopted or retired without one is a lint warning per REQ-04/REQ-07) | review_by (ISO date). CAP: 12 rows at status=adopted per lane; at the cap a new adoption names its displacement and the retire proposal rides with it. Phase 00 ships this schema and zero rows (ADR-0606: empty seed); the status lint, cap and displacement checks are Phase 02.
